title: Telangana Cyber Security Bureau arrests two men from Kurnool over movie piracy network
date_note: The page, updated 22 November, gives no earlier day for the arrests.
geo_basis: agency headquarters (TGCSB, Telangana); arrested men are from Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh
summary: Telangana Today reports that the Telangana Cyber Security Bureau (TGCSB) arrested two 19-year-olds from Kurnool over a movie piracy network. They allegedly filmed new releases in a Kurnool cinema, uploaded the recordings to Gofile.com and a piracy website, and the prime accused allegedly coordinated via Telegram. Police seized three mobile phones; efforts continue to trace other members and cryptocurrency transactions.
plain: Telangana's cyber police arrested two 19-year-olds from Kurnool for allegedly filming new movies in a cinema and sharing them on a piracy site.
exec: Film piracy rings are being targeted by police; TGCSB says piracy can also enable betting and financial fraud.
impact: Two arrests, three phones seized; other members still being traced, per investigators.

validation.note: Telangana Today only, relaying TGCSB statements; no second publisher read.

review.note: stronger than source (Telegram channels distribution); removed unsupported fraud tag
